To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the presence of a humanoid robot in the classroom can help children with autism to learn social and academic skills.

(1) the presence of a humanoid robot in a learning and therapeutic environment helps to increase the number of trials, reduce the response time, increase the response quality, and increase the behavior retention in children with Autism Spectrum Disorder.

Children with ASD showed significant improvement in social and academic skills when they were taught with a humanoid robot present with the human teacher as compared to when they were taught by a human teacher alone.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a low-cost humanoid robot system that is used as a teacher's assistant for helping children with autism to learn social and academic skills.
how to make the robot a good teaching assistant, how to make the children with ASD to learn more effectively and how to improve their social skills through robot interaction.
developing and evaluating a robotic toy system for children with ASD to help them learn social and academic skills.

the use of robots as teachers' assistants in therapeutic and learning activities is a promising and effective method of helping children with ASD.
a robotic teacher's assistant can be a very effective tool to help children with ASD to learn social and academic skills.
